library.kw_123:r_b8ee157ce285cf0d.text:
Its official name is the Republic of $$クルジス$$.
A nation in the Middle East, and also $$刹那$$'s homeland.
Amid conflict, it was forcibly annexed by the neighboring Kingdom of Azadistan, and it no longer exists.

library.kw_123:r_bb8fc3c736f4cca6.text:
An anti-government guerrilla organization in the Republic of $$クルジス$$ in the Middle East.
Its leader was Ali $$アル$$-Saachez, and $$刹那$$ belonged to it as a child.
Through Saachez's mental control, which held neither faith nor ideology, the child soldiers who belonged to it carried out numerous inhumane acts of terrorism both at home and abroad.
The $$ＫＰＳＡ$$ was also the perpetrator of the terrorist attack that took the Dylandy siblings' family.

library.kw_123:r_1e1f299a3e781af6.text:
A psychological term for a realm beyond individual consciousness that exists in the depths of the human mind.
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ described it as 'a place where people's hearts and memories gather, transcending time and space.'
Charles and Marianne sought to gather the consciousness of all humanity into it, eliminating the concepts of time and the individual, in order to create a world without lies where everything became one.
However, this was rejected by $$ルルーシュ$$, who sought a future instead, and the two of them had their existence erased.

library.kw_123:r_72560b5c2ff2c6fb.text:
An organization founded by Charles zi Britannia to research $$ギアス$$.
Rolo, $$ルルーシュ$$'s false younger brother, was also dispatched from here, and $$ジェレミア・ゴットバルト$$'s $$ギアス$$ Canceller was developed here as well.
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ was once its leader, but after she left the Order, Charles's real elder brother V.V., who likewise held a Code, took her place.
It was annihilated by $$ルルーシュ$$, who was enraged at losing his friend Shirley Fenette to the power of $$ギアス$$.
Also, deep within the Order's headquarters lies a door leading to the $$黄昏の間$$.

library.kw_123:r_e5bf87194998f017.text:
Information terminals created to carry out Aeolia Schoenberg's plan, possessing forms identical to humans.
They are capable of sensory abilities within the $$脳量子波$$ field using GN Particles, a quantum computation system, a link to $$ヴェーダ$$, and suppression of aging through genetic manipulation and nanomachines.
Ribbons Almark and the others like him existed to watch over the emergence of the Innovators, who were seen as the next stage of humanity, but he claimed the title of Innovator for himself and sought to control mankind.

library.kw_123:r_819d0aa9d8831607.text:
A conference held in the final stages of the $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$, where the leaders of opposing organizations gathered to discuss the future direction of the world. It was named for the location where it was held, the lunar city of Copernicus.
The conference ultimately ended in failure, and the battles among the various factions moved toward a final showdown.

library.kw_123:r_51dff9d23924ed59.text:
Her full name is $$マルグリット$$ Pistel.
A member of the Ark Saber of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$, which ruled the Earth of a parallel world. She holds the rank of High Knight Number 7 and pilots the Pearl Nail.
Before $$インサラウム$$ was destroyed by the King of Destruction, she served as captain of the Royal Guard protecting the king's family, and her dignified conduct in public made her an idol among the people as the flower of the Ark Saber.
When $$インサラウム$$ was annihilated, she became a subordinate of the King of Destruction through $$アイム$$ Liard's intercession.
She has a fastidious, proud character and desires to fight fair, honorable battles. Because of this, while she belonged to the $$新帝国インペリウム$$, she reluctantly followed $$アイム$$'s orders, which spared no method.
As a member of the Ark Saber, she swore loyalty to $$ユーサー$$ once again, but chose to fight against him for the sake of the justice she believed in and her homeland's future.
After $$ユーサー$$ fell, she honored his true wishes and became a leader of $$インサラウム$$, setting off for Mars together with 500 million people.

library.kw_123:r_887bcda2cda677f2.text:
Its official name is the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$.
An absolute monarchy that once unified the Earth of a parallel world, with a history of roughly 2,000 years.
Its defense organization, the Ark Saber, adhered to a policy of purely defensive warfare and had protected humanity from alien life forms and extraterrestrials, but it was defeated by the King of Destruction. $$インサラウム$$ was further destroyed by the runaway of $$ＺＯＮＥ$$, its $$次元力$$ extraction system.
Afterward, under the command of $$ユーサー$$ $$インサラウム$$, the next Holy King, it invaded the $$ＡＤＷ$$, but was defeated by $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$. However, by taking on all responsibility for the war himself, $$ユーサー$$ ensured $$インサラウム$$'s citizens were accepted, and they became settlers on Mars.
In the research of $$次元力$$, $$インサラウム$$ was more advanced than the $$ＡＤＷ$$ or the $$ＵＣＷ$$, but with the death of its central figure, $$アンブローン・ジウス$$, much of its achievements were lost.

library.kw_123:r_4cb7c77cdb8fc250.text:
A $$次元力$$ extraction system developed by $$アンブローン・ジウス$$ of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$. Its name is short for 'Zodiac Of New Energy.'
It is installed along ley lines to extract the Earth's $$次元力$$, but in $$インサラウム$$, the runaway of $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ caused the land itself to die.
During the $$再世戦争$$, five units were installed on Earth and one on Mars; they still exist today, but all of them have ceased functioning.

library.kw_123:r_e06a9f9888ae1cc4.text:
Prime Minister of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$, which ruled the Earth of a parallel world.
She was originally the Director of the Bureau of Science and Technology, and after $$インサラウム$$ was destroyed by the King of Destruction, she was appointed Prime Minister amid the chaos and advised Prince $$ユーサー$$ to invade the parallel world.
She devoted her life to the forbidden pursuit of dimensional science, and the fruits of her research, the artificial $$次元獣$$ series, became a major military force in $$インサラウム$$'s invasion of Earth.
In the final battle on Mars, she transformed herself into the artificial $$次元獣$$ Exa Adamon and fought, but was defeated by $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ and met her end.
Her death also brought $$インサラウム$$'s research into dimensional science to a standstill.

library.kw_123:r_bf100303e81e1ad9.text:
An alternate name for $$次元力$$. Also called the Power of the Source Principle.
Those with a high degree of understanding of $$次元力$$, or who have touched the $$黒の英知$$, tend to use this name.

library.kw_123:r_8a8b021f56e57abe.text:
A term used by the Protodeviln to refer to high-dimensional energy and its possessor.
In the past, it is said that the one who sealed the Protodeviln on the ice planet was a possessor of this $$アニマスピリチア$$, and its power has properties directly opposite to Spiritia, the Protodeviln's energy source, dealing them damage.
The Protodeviln regarded $$熱気バサラ$$ of Fire Bomber as a threat, believing him to be an $$アニマスピリチア$$.

library.kw_123:r_e65ba7673105a161.text:
The overseer of the Protodeviln.
It possesses the body of Staff Officer Ivano Gunter of the U.N. Spacy, but its true form is the largest among the Protodeviln.
The Protodeviln require human bio-energy, Spiritia. To avoid repeating the past failure of falling dormant due to a Spiritia shortage, $$ゲペルニッチ$$ planned the 'Spiritia Farm Project' and attacked the $$マクロス７$$ fleet and other emigrant fleets.
Its main body possesses an absorption ability that could be called a black hole of Spiritia, and it continued to drain Spiritia from the entire $$マクロス７$$ fleet.
In the end, inspired by $$バサラ$$, it sang a song of its own and evolved into a race that could regenerate Spiritia on its own without needing to absorb it from others, then flew off to another galaxy.

library.kw_123:r_333d5ff44619b103.text:
A legendary songstress said to have led humanity to victory through the power of song in the First Space War.
Some of the Zentraedi, who regained their culture through her songs, sided with the humans of Earth to fight those who denied that culture.
That conflict was also made into a film, known as well for its love-triangle story between $$リン・ミンメイ$$ and a man and woman belonging to the U.N. Spacy, but her romance ended in tragedy.
$$リン・ミンメイ$$ joined the first ultra-long-range emigrant fleet, and her whereabouts thereafter remain unknown.

library.kw_123:r_fcb6edf80f755525.text:
A book written by $$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$, the former president of Paradigm Corporation.
It is said to depict the end of the world that occurred more than 40 years ago, but the truth of this is unknown.

library.kw_123:r_bcacd1c68762c345.text:
A crystalline formation used to extract energy from another dimension.
Its name is short for 'Dimension Energy Crystal,' and it is also called a dimensional crystal.
It is a substance indispensable to the study of super-dimensional physics, and on Earth it can only be mined in limited regions, making it a high-value trade good.
The former Republic of Limonesia was the largest producer of it, and thanks to $$ＤＥＣ$$ exports, it held strong international influence despite being a small nation.
It also exists on the Earth of a parallel world; the crystal portion of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$'s $$次元力$$ extraction system, $$ＺＯＮＥ$$, is a massive mass of $$ＤＥＣ$$.

library.kw_123:r_282363406bbb8218.text:
The price paid for a $$スフィア・リアクター$$ drawing out a $$スフィア$$'s power.
At the stage where a $$スフィア$$ is used simply as a power source, there is no notable harm, but once the $$スフィア$$ reaches the stage of controlling phenomena, backlash occurs.
The symptoms differ depending on the $$スフィア$$, but a connection can be seen to the aspect of the human mind each $$スフィア$$ governs - for instance, the backlash of the 'False Black Sheep,' which governs lies, takes the form of being unable to speak the truth.

library.kw_123:r_0c19c1550b55c882.text:
The price paid for a $$スフィア・リアクター$$ drawing out a $$スフィア$$'s power.
At the stage where a $$スフィア$$ is used simply as a power source, there is no notable harm, but once the $$スフィア$$ reaches the stage of controlling phenomena, backlash occurs.
The symptoms differ depending on the $$スフィア$$, but a connection can be seen to the aspect of the human mind each $$スフィア$$ governs - for instance, the backlash of the 'False Black Sheep,' which governs lies, takes the form of being unable to speak the truth.
Since Gadlite Meonsam, who calls himself a Third Stage Reactor, showed no apparent symptoms, it is believed that as control over a $$スフィア$$ advances further, the backlash becomes increasingly suppressed and eventually harmless. Conversely, this suggests that overcoming the backlash is a condition for a Reactor to advance to a further stage.

library.kw_123:r_5821bd2f58f4a2d1.text:
A $$次元獣$$ Buster belonging to Scort Labo.
The sole survivor of Audis, a rural town in North America where a Rhino Damon-class $$次元獣$$ first appeared.
Her harrowing experience left her with strong anger and hatred toward Dimensional Beasts, but through meeting various people, she gradually regained her originally honest nature. That said, she is prone to strong convictions, for better or worse, and her enthusiasm sometimes runs away with her.
After the $$破界事変$$, she followed in the footsteps of Crow, whom she admired, and became a $$次元獣$$ Buster, taking on the mission of hunting down Dimensional Beasts appearing around the world alongside her machine, the Buster Es.
In the course of battle, she was transformed into an artificial $$次元獣$$, but miraculously recovered. Several mysteries remain regarding her body.

library.kw_123:r_6d51253db39a52d5.text:
A $$次元獣$$ Buster belonging to Scort Labo.
The sole survivor of Audis, a rural town in North America where a Rhino Damon-class $$次元獣$$ first appeared.
Her harrowing experience left her with strong anger and hatred toward Dimensional Beasts, but through meeting various people, she gradually regained her originally honest nature. That said, she is prone to strong convictions, for better or worse, and her enthusiasm sometimes runs away with her.
After the $$破界事変$$, she followed in the footsteps of Crow, whom she admired, and became a $$次元獣$$ Buster, taking on the mission of hunting down Dimensional Beasts appearing around the world alongside her machine, the Buster Es.
In the course of battle, she was transformed into an artificial $$次元獣$$, but miraculously recovered. Several mysteries remain regarding her body.
As for her current whereabouts, they remain unknown.
